conceptTitle: She Found A Receipt In His Coat. The Date Was Their Anniversary.

footage.loopStrategy: trim first 5 seconds backseat night city

onScreenHook:
She found a receipt in his coat.
A restaurant. The date:
their ANNIVERSARY.
He said he worked late that night.
She kept the receipt for six months.
caption:
She wasn't looking for anything.

She was hanging up his coat — the grey one, the one he wore to the office — and she felt something stiff in the inside pocket.

A receipt. Paper, folded once.

A restaurant she'd never been to. For two. $187 including tip.

The date printed at the top was October 14th.

Their anniversary.

He had called her that night at 7:30 to say he was going to be late. A client dinner had run long. He sounded normal. He asked if she'd eaten.

She put the receipt back in the pocket.

She hung up the coat.

She made herself a cup of tea.

She didn't say anything that night. Or the next night. Or for six months.

She spent those six months watching. Not obsessively — she didn't go through his phone. She just paid attention differently. She learned things you only see when you stop expecting honesty.

On a Saturday in April she put the receipt on the kitchen table between them.

She said, 'I found this in October.'

The look on his face told her everything she needed to know about who he was.
